name: @madison/site
description: Madison's published marketing site — the production shell deployed to Netlify. Owns no page content: it mounts @madison/sandbox's prototypes at their public slugs.

scripts.//build: Client bundle → SSR bundle → prerender. The prerender step needs both: dist/index.html as its template and dist-ssr/entry-server.js to render from.
scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && bun run scripts/prerender.ts
scripts.build:seo-audit: SEO_AUDIT=true VITE_SEO_AUDIT=true SITE_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4174 bun run build
